geometry_changes: None. Original positions, topology, bevel widths, hierarchy and all animation keys preserved. Flat principal planes, smooth bevel patches and applied weighted corner normals only.
color_space: All numeric RGB values below are scene-linear, not sRGB swatches.

inner.name: Inner Precision Metal
inner.machining_axis: local Y, along the depth of each ring

core.name: Core Light Material
core.strategy: Single Principled dielectric surface, restrained emission. Actual Cycles mesh-emission GI; no hidden auxiliary core lights, bloom or composited aura.

web_translation.direct: Base color, metallic, roughness, inward geometric bevel and corner normals, modest emissive color/intensity; three material slots
web_translation.bake_or_rebuild: Object-space noise to UV base-color/roughness/tangent-normal textures, with texel density and seam padding; anisotropy requires an appropriate physical material
web_translation.preview_only: Cycles multi-bounce GI, softbox rig, denoiser, AgX display transform and floor. Principled emission does not guarantee matching realtime light on surrounding metal.
